entities.name: Essential thrombocythemia
observations: Age >60 years and JAK2 V617F positivity confer high thrombotic risk; cytoreductive therapy is generally indicated. (PMID: 7700286; PMID: 27913539)

entities.name: Hydroxyurea
observations: Randomized evidence supports hydroxyurea for thrombosis prevention in high-risk essential thrombocythemia. (PMID: 7700286)

entities.name: Acquired vWF risk
observations: With extreme thrombocytosis (>1,000,000/µL), evaluate von Willebrand activity including ristocetin cofactor before aspirin because acquired von Willebrand syndrome can increase bleeding risk. (PMID: 27913539)
